items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: I got that idea from the Tiffany. I used to go out to Palace Theater a lot... they had that fellow, I forgot his name, but that was a wonderful drummer

ctx.x: Johnny Sincere used to go to sleep playing guitar, I remember. Yeah. I wanted to ask you about tuning your drums, you told me about that the other day.

Oh yeah, yeah. Well now, I used to tune my drum in G, with the G string on the bass. That's the bass drum? That's the bass drum. It'd get a beautiful sound. And then you can tune with either one of them strings, it'd depend, you know. Now sometimes I used to tune my drum, like a lot of times we used to play a lot of stuff in G and D, you know, in A and stuff like that.
